Stress-space separable forms and Voce/Hollomon-with-shift forms all stayed at 4e-5 or worse. The remaining residual suggests a term I haven't identified.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*T + p[3]*T**2 + L*(p[4] + p[5]*S + p[6]*T + p[7]/T) + L**2*(p[8] + p[9]*S) + 0*L**3
    return np.exp(z)
